# The touched OData filter URI test has no assertion message

serialize_message_delta_with_filter checks the exact encoded URI with assert_eq!(*uri, expected), but supplies no failure message. The assertion predates the constructor-path cleanup and remains in the touched function. A focused test repair should add a nonempty message that states the expected URI behavior and contains should. No test ran, and this does not claim the cleanup introduced the omission.

Scope: Graph OData URI test diagnostics.
